column1: # Which BIOS files a system needs, by ROM folder. Machine-readable companion
# to bios-required.txt, which is the prose version and says the same things.
# "any" means one of them is enough -- the Sega CD wants the BIOS for the
# region of the disc, and somebody with only American discs needs only the
# American one. "all" means every file listed.
# Only systems that cannot run without one are here. Everything else --  NES,
# SNES, Mega Drive cartridges, Nintendo 64, Master System, Game Gear, the
# Ataris, most home computers -- needs nothing.
# retrobox-ready reads this and says which of these you actually need, which
# is only ever the ones you have games for.
